utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I should like to bid good afternoon to everyone in the courtroom. Could the Registrar please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. Case number IT-00-41-PT, the Prosecutor versus Pasko Ljubicic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Madam Registrar. Could the parties introduce themselves for the record, please. Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. HARMON
utterances.text: Yes. Good afternoon, Judge El Mahdi. My name is Mark Harmon. I represent the Office of the Prosecutor, along with my colleague, Mr. Fergal Gaynor, who is my co-counsel. To my left is Ms. Donnica Henry Frijlink, the case manager. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much, Mr. Harmon. Yes. Defence, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. JONJIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honour. My name is Tomislav Jonjic, representing the accused in this case.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Mr. Jonjic. Mr. Ljubicic, can you hear me in a language that you understand?

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Microphone for the accused, please.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, yes, I can hear you very well.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much. Please sit down. Let me remind the parties that the last Status Conference was held in September, on the 25th of September, and despite the fact that we have had a conference in November as well, I wanted to be in strict compliance of the provisions of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence and respect the time limits provided for in the Rules. Having said that, I should like to move into private session. [In English] Madam Registrar, could we go into closed session, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: We are in private session, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: We are in open session, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Madam Registrar. Mr. Ljubicic, as regards your health, how do you feel? Do you have any complaints? Is there anything you would like to say to the Chamber?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, my health condition is currently good. I don't have any complaints about my life in the Detention Unit. I don't have any complaints about the personnel or anything that has to do with my stay in the Detention Unit.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much. You may be seated. I am very happy to hear what you have just said. Would the parties like to raise any issue, or would they like to inform the Chamber about any issue? Mr. Harmon.

utterances.speaker: MR. HARMON
utterances.text: No, Your Honour. Thank you for the invitation.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Jonjic.

utterances.speaker: MR. JONJIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, the Defence doesn't know whether financing should be raised at this point. Is that something that has been envisaged as something to be discussed during this Status Conference or not? Can we already start discussing that?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] What do you mean by "financing"? What do you mean by "finances"?

utterances.speaker: MR. JONJIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] On the agenda that I have received from Mr. Harhoff, one of the items on the agenda of today's Status Conference is the financing of the Defence, and Mr. Harhoff has informed us that the trial is not going to start before the upcoming autumn. So Mr. Harhoff and I have exchanged several e-mails and discussed our financing, because that is something that is of concern, and a late start of the trial will have a bearing on that. However, if that hasn't been envisaged as an item on the agenda of today's Status Conference, maybe the Defence shouldn't raise this issue at this point.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE EL MAHDI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Very well, then. I think that this issue should be regulated with our Senior Legal Officer. However, I would like to tell you that I personally would like to be able to start this trial as soon as possible. However, as you may well be aware of, this does not depend on the Tribunal; it depends on part -- partly on some issues which are beyond our power. Since we are in open session, I will -- I'm sure you will certainly understand that I -- what I'm trying to say to you. So it depends very much on others, not so much on us. It depends, rather, on some external circumstances. I hope that you will be able to regulate this issue and that everything will be in the interest of justice. Like every time so far, I am inviting you to regulate this issue with Mr. Harhoff, who is more than capable of dealing with this issue in this stage of pre-trial. Having said that, if there's nothing else to raise, I think I can declare this session adjourned. Thank you very much.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the Status Conference adjourned at
